machine: Tandy 1000 RSX, i386SX 25 MHz, 4096 KiB, no dynarec, host RTC sync disabled, guest network disconnected, no mounted floppy/CD
transport: 86Box 7.0 held authenticated loopback TCP, visible no-hook launch, seed 1
checkpoint_note: type uses US set 1 with | as Enter; paced splits each line into up to six characters with 85 ms pauses then Enter and 190 ms; tap/mod use set-1 keys with extended 0x100 flag. Mouse probes were native socket relative events with buttons released.
disk_transfer: 7-Zip extraction of stopped disks and independent FAT16 chain traversal agreed for all selected native formats.
time_basis: Elapsed emulated ms from held boot at zero, including time consumed by key events; framebuffer is the last rendered frame.
